description: Cereal staples forming the base of India's food security system
typical_crops_examples: Rice, Wheat, Maize, Barley
data_source: ICAR; Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
notes: Largest acreage group; MSP-procured

description: Nutri-cereals; drought-tolerant coarse grains
typical_crops_examples: Pearl Millet, Sorghum, Finger Millet, Foxtail Millet
notes: Priority group under national nutri-cereals push

description: Leguminous protein crops that also fix atmospheric nitrogen
typical_crops_examples: Chickpea, Pigeon Pea, Moong, Urad, Lentil
notes: National Food Security Mission - Pulses focus

description: Oil-bearing crops feeding the edible-oil and oil-cake economy
typical_crops_examples: Groundnut, Soybean, Sunflower, Safflower, Mustard
notes: Edible-oil import substitution priority

description: Non-food cash crops supplying industrial value chains
typical_crops_examples: Sugarcane, Cotton, Tobacco, Jute
data_source: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare; Commodity Boards
notes: Mill/industry-linked procurement

description: Short-duration high-value vegetable crops
typical_crops_examples: Tomato, Potato, Onion, Brinjal, Okra, Cabbage
notes: MIDH-supported; high perishability

description: Perennial and semi-perennial fruit crops
typical_crops_examples: Mango, Banana, Citrus, Grapes, Guava, Pomegranate
notes: Long gestation; strong export pull

description: Aromatic and pungent spice crops
typical_crops_examples: Turmeric, Chilli, Black Pepper, Cardamom, Coriander, Cumin
notes: India is the largest global spice exporter

description: Herbal and aromatic crops for AYUSH and nutraceutical use
typical_crops_examples: Ashwagandha, Tulsi, Brahmi, Shatavari, Aloe Vera
data_source: National Medicinal Plants Board (NMPB); Ministry of Ayush
notes: Buy-back contracts common; quality testing critical

description: Long-duration perennial estate crops
typical_crops_examples: Coconut, Arecanut, Tea, Coffee, Rubber, Cashew
notes: Board-regulated; multi-decade crop cycles

description: Cut flowers and loose flowers for floriculture markets
typical_crops_examples: Rose, Marigold, Chrysanthemum, Jasmine, Gerbera
notes: Festival-driven demand spikes; cold chain sensitive

description: Green and dry fodder crops supporting livestock systems
typical_crops_examples: Berseem, Lucerne, Fodder Sorghum, Fodder Maize, Oats
data_source: ICAR-IGFRI (Indian Grassland and Fodder Research Institute)
notes: Input to dairy/livestock rather than direct sale

description: Non-timber forest produce collected or cultivated at forest margins
typical_crops_examples: Tamarind, Mahua, Gum Karaya, Bamboo, Sal Seed, Honey (wild)
data_source: TRIFED; Ministry of Tribal Affairs; State Forest Departments
notes: MSP-for-MFP scheme; tribal livelihood linked

description: Certified chemical-free production system rather than a crop group
typical_crops_examples: Any crop under NPOP/PGS certification
data_source: APEDA (NPOP); PKVY under Ministry of Agriculture
notes: System category; 3-year conversion for NPOP certification

description: Polyhouse, shadenet and greenhouse-based controlled cultivation
typical_crops_examples: Capsicum, Gerbera, Cucumber, Exotic Vegetables
data_source: MIDH (Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture)
notes: Capital-intensive; MIDH subsidy-supported

description: Soil-less cultivation in nutrient solution
typical_crops_examples: Lettuce, Leafy Greens, Herbs, Strawberry
notes: Urban/peri-urban model; standardised cost data sparse

description: Integrated fish-and-plant recirculating system
typical_crops_examples: Leafy Greens with Tilapia / Carp
notes: Early adoption in India; limited published cost benchmarks

description: Silkworm rearing with host-plant cultivation
typical_crops_examples: Mulberry (host), Tasar, Eri, Muga host plants
data_source: Central Silk Board; Ministry of Textiles
notes: Silk Samagra scheme support; high employment per acre

description: Beekeeping for honey, wax and pollination services
typical_crops_examples: Apis cerana indica, Apis mellifera colonies
notes: National Beekeeping and Honey Mission (NBHM)

description: Protected-shed fungal cultivation on prepared substrate
typical_crops_examples: Button Mushroom, Oyster Mushroom, Milky Mushroom
notes: Short cycle; year-round income; low land requirement

description: Inland and brackish-water fish and shrimp culture
typical_crops_examples: Rohu, Catla, Tilapia, Vannamei Shrimp
notes: PMMSY-funded; highest-value agri-export category

description: Small and large ruminant rearing for meat and by-products
typical_crops_examples: Goat, Sheep, Buffalo, Cattle
data_source: Department of Animal Husbandry & Dairying; National Livestock Mission
notes: National Livestock Mission support

description: Broiler, layer and backyard poultry production
typical_crops_examples: Broiler, Layer, Kadaknath, Giriraja
data_source: Department of Animal Husbandry & Dairying; ICAR-DPR
notes: Short cycle; integrator contract-farming common

description: Milk production and primary milk handling
typical_crops_examples: Buffalo Milk, Cow Milk (crossbred and indigenous)
data_source: NDDB; Department of Animal Husbandry & Dairying
notes: Cooperative procurement network; daily cash flow
